note: Loss limits score a fixed T+5 policy. They are not refit and they are not a sell rule. Policy C holds RECOVERING and sells every other state.

rules.strong: anchored -10% tail fall, precision and recall both >= 50, cost per 1pp below 0.5, and break-even lambda at most 1
rules.partial: anchored -10% tail fall is present even when false defensive sells or missed gains are large
rules.relativeReduction: At zero cost, relative tail reduction equals recall, because a sale sets the return to 0 and does not create a new tail.

RECOVERING.note: Policy C holds RECOVERING, so this state has no defensive sells. Tail events in this state remain inside the held book.

STILL_FALLING.note: Policy C sells every STILL_FALLING event, so recall inside this state is definitional. Precision is the share of this state that breaches the limit.
